overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, academically focused cross-platform presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon with a total reach of 3,580 followers. His content centers around computational social science, disinformation research, software releases (CooRnet), and academic recruitment. Engagement is robust across all channels, with LinkedIn driving the highest total volume of interactions and Bluesky showing strong amplification through reposts.

contentThemes.description: Announcements of new research papers, grants awarded, and conference presentations regarding coordinated inauthentic behavior.
Updates on open-source tools developed by the research team, such as CooRnet v2.0.
Hiring posts for postdoctoral researchers and research opportunities for PhD students.
Reflections on multi-platform computational research methods and disinformation studies.

recommendations: Cross-promote major research breakthroughs and tool releases simultaneously across all platforms to maximize initial reach.
Leverage LinkedIn specifically for career and recruitment updates, as it generates high comment-based interaction.
Increase posting frequency on Mastodon and Bluesky to build stronger community ties and encourage continuous resharing of academic open-source tools.

platformInsights.bluesky: Demonstrates high engagement-per-follower with exceptional repost rates, making it highly effective for spreading new research papers and academic calls.
platformInsights.mastodon: Serves as an effective niche audience hub for open-source tool updates (CooRnet) and technical methodological discussions, though engagement volume is lower.
platformInsights.linkedin: Commands the largest follower base (1,850) and yields the highest absolute engagement per post, particularly for grant announcements and hiring opportunities.
